description: Department of Local Government - Northern Province - Notify to Convene the meeting again for the election of Chairman of Valvettithurai Urban Council in Norther Province On 22.09.2021 at 10.00 am at the Hall of the Valvettithurai Urban Council
categorisation: This gazette notice announces the reconvening of a meeting for the election of a Chairman for the Valvettithurai Urban Council. The content is specifically related to an electoral process at the local government level, falling under the category of "Election announcements and schedules" as defined for Type 7 (Elections Gazettes). While it names an official (the Commissioner), this is in the context of issuing an electoral notice, not a government personnel appointment or change. The primary focus is on the electoral procedure, not on government structure or a personnel change.
